about: Todd Maybrown, an attorney with Allen, Hansen, Maybrown & Offenbecher in Seattle, Washington, helps clients address Criminal Defense situations. He also helps clients with Appellate and Civil Litigation: Defense concerns.
He received legal training from The University of Michigan Law School. He graduated from law school in 1988. Todd Maybrown became licensed to practice law in 1989.
Todd Maybrown was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Super Lawyers for 2001 - 2003, 2005 - 2026.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
